svg.title: Minecraft Potion Brewing Chart
svg.desc: A complete Survival brewing reference: nineteen effect potions, bases, effect ingredients, duration extensions, strength upgrades and Java/Bedrock differences. Read the accessible recipe cards at axelgamer.com/minecraft/potion-brewing-chart/.

g.text: 19 Survival recipes • Java + Bedrock • Drinkable potion timers
Stand: 1 blaze rod + 3 cobblestone • Bottles: 3 glass → 3 bottles
J = Java • B = Bedrock • — = no upgrade
White/green rows start with Awkward Potion. Purple rows use the named starting bottle.
Glowstone → higher level (II, or Slowness IV)
Choose one. You cannot combine both upgrades.
Brew the effect, then upgrade, then change its form.
• Weakness skips nether wart: Water bottle + fermented spider eye.
• Fermented spider eye = spider eye + sugar + brown mushroom (crafting).
• Turtle Master II = Resistance IV + Slowness VI; normal = Resistance III + Slowness IV.
• Splash/lingering timers differ from this table; check the bottle tooltip and impact distance.
• Mundane/Thick have no useful Survival branch. Luck/Decay cannot be brewed in Survival.
